technique_name: Identify the factors that determine the cost of renting a house.
description: The cost of renting a house is determined by a number of factors, including the location, size of the house, amenities and features of the house, the landlord's inquiry process, and the local market conditions. Location is a major factor as tenants may prioritize living in an area that is close to where they work, while the size of the house and features such as parking availability and extra living space could also drive up prices.
